1.w: A psalm of David. O Lord, I cry out to you. Come quickly to me. Pay attention to me when I cry out to you.

2.w: May you accept my prayer like incense, my uplifted hands like the evening offering.

3.w: O Lord, place a guard on my mouth. Protect the opening of my lips.

4.w: Do not let me have evil desires or participate in sinful activities with men who behave wickedly. I will not eat their delicacies.

5.w: May the godly strike me in love and correct me. May my head not refuse choice oil. Indeed, my prayer is a witness against their evil deeds.

6.w: They will be thrown over the side of a cliff by their judges. They will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.

7.w: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

8.w: Surely I am looking to you, O Sovereign Lord. In you I take shelter. Do not expose me to danger.

9.w: Protect me from the snare they have laid for me and the traps the evildoers have set.

10.w: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I escape.
